About.title: About Print Orbit
About.subtitle: The printing powerhouse of Kangra valley.

About.infrastructure_desc: Our facility is equipped with the latest offset and digital printing presses, ensuring razor-sharp precision and consistent color reproduction for every single page.
About.trust_desc: Serving the heartbeat of Kangra—from healthcare providers to cultural organizations—we've built a reputation for reliability and excellence.
